_comment: iBM Lab 文献捕获桥共享安全 spec（单点事实源）。三处实现必须消费本文件或与本文件保持一致，防安全边界漂移：browser-extension/ibm-literature-capture/background.js（MV3 SW 异步加载扩展内副本）、browser-extension/ibm-literature-capture/native-bridge/host.py（开发回退桥）、desktop/src-tauri/resources/bridge/host.js（桌面原生宿主）。两处镜像文件必须逐字节一致：browser-extension/ibm-literature-capture/capture-spec.json 与 desktop/src-tauri/resources/bridge/capture-spec.json（tests/unit/native-bridge-host.test.mjs 断言）。

_captureSemantics.viewerIsNotCapture: documentType=application/pdf and contentLength describe the displayed response, not saved bytes. Agent may trigger native viewer download; publisher HTML preview requires clicking its download element. A wrong-object-html verdict means the preview buffer is not a ready PDF payload.
_captureSemantics.captureStarts: An active task receives a WebView2 DownloadEvent::Requested, or the response collector receives a complete non-206 application/pdf body; Nature/Springer public SI may be intercepted before preview navigation.
_captureSemantics.progress: Browser-download received bytes come from the actual destination file. Viewer response buffers are separate and never counted as downloaded bytes. Unknown total means no percent or ETA.
_captureSemantics.completion: Only validated upload and bundle registration complete the task. Native viewer saving is initiated through the viewer action and tracked to that terminal state. Manual Ctrl+S in the native viewer uses the same automatic capture and archive path; no user-supplied file path is needed.
